ravi: quick heads-up, opened PR to tidy streaming/pagination snippets. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/640
nina: ETA on fixes?
omar: Main items: TS uses old client.stream(), Python backoff needs jitter, Go needs resume token persistence example.
ravi: For Python, use a compact jitter helper:
```
import random, time

def backoff(attempt, base=0.3, cap=8):
    delay = min(cap, base * (2 ** attempt)) + random.uniform(0, base)
    time.sleep(delay)
```
omar: For Go I'll show a tiny file store for resume tokens:
```
// read
b, _ := os.ReadFile("/tmp/rw_resume")
req.ResumeToken = string(b)
// after checkpoint
_ = os.WriteFile("/tmp/rw_resume", []byte(newTok), 0644)
```
nina: TS fix: change to client.chat.stream() and show AbortController and for-await pattern.
ravi: Also add a short migration note: v1.3 chat streaming moved under client.chat.*; resume_token is opaque.
